🕵️ Shadow Trader Digest – 01 August 2026


Three under-the-radar events that might quietly move markets this week:



  1. 🇺🇸 Softs contract roll — cocoa, cotton, Coffee advent
    Friday, 07 August · ICE Futures U.S.
    Roll advisories reprice the curves mechanically; spreads widen into first-notice.
    Source →

  2. 🇺🇸 ISM manufacturing PMI
    Monday, 03 August · ISM
    The supply-managers truth serum; the new-orders subindex is the tell desks trade.
    Source →

  3. 🇲🇽 CPI — year-on-year print
    Friday, 07 August · INEGI
    Mexican inflation with heavy Banxico path sensitivity; MXN proxy flow.
    Source →


Stay hidden. Stay ahead.
— Goldirham Whisper
